targets.rawSql: SELECT observed_at AS time,avg(cpu_utilization_percent) AS "CPU" FROM telemetry.server_metrics sm JOIN inventory.servers sv ON sv.id=sm.server_id JOIN inventory.racks r ON r.id=sv.rack_id JOIN inventory.data_center_rows dr ON dr.id=r.row_id JOIN inventory.rooms rm ON rm.id=dr.room_id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=rm.site_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR s.site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${server:sqlstring}='All' OR sv.server_key=${server:sqlstring}) GROUP BY observed_at ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT ON (sm.server_id) s.name AS "Data Center",sv.hostname AS "Server",sm.observed_at AS "Observed At",round(sm.cpu_utilization_percent::numeric,1) AS "CPU %",round(sm.memory_utilization_percent::numeric,1) AS "Memory %",pg_size_pretty(sm.storage_free_bytes) AS "Storage Free",round(sm.disk_read_iops::numeric,1) AS "Read IOPS",round(sm.disk_write_iops::numeric,1) AS "Write IOPS",round(sm.disk_latency_ms::numeric,2) AS "Disk Latency ms",round(sm.bandwidth_utilization_percent::numeric,1) AS "Bandwidth %",round(sm.network_latency_ms::numeric,2) AS "Network Latency ms",round(sm.packet_loss_percent::numeric,3) AS "Packet Loss %",round(sm.temperature_celsius::numeric,1) AS "Temp °C",round(sm.humidity_percent::numeric,1) AS "Humidity %",round(sm.airflow_cfm::numeric,1) AS "Airflow CFM",round(sm.pue::numeric,3) AS "PUE",round(sm.power_consumption_watts::numeric,1) AS "Power W",round(sm.uptime_percent::numeric,3) AS "Uptime %",round(sm.error_rate_per_minute::numeric,3) AS "Errors/min",CASE WHEN sm.is_simulated THEN 'Simulated' ELSE 'Live' END AS "Data Type" FROM telemetry.server_metrics sm JOIN inventory.servers sv ON sv.id=sm.server_id JOIN inventory.racks r ON r.id=sv.rack_id JOIN inventory.data_center_rows dr ON dr.id=r.row_id JOIN inventory.rooms rm ON rm.id=dr.room_id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=rm.site_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring}='All' OR s.site_key=${site:sqlstring}) AND (${server:sqlstring}='All' OR sv.server_key=${server:sqlstring}) ORDER BY sm.server_id,sm.observed_at DESC
